summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview; evidence_needed for the underlying control set. Exact decision: retain searchwoot.com as private and reject public launch, monetization expansion, credential, telemetry, infrastructure, schedule, and deployment changes this cycle. Evidence: the read-only security baseline reports no completed deployment, uptime, error, authentication, authorization, secret-handling, runtime-isolation, release-control, dependency, monitoring, incident-response, or disclosure-readiness evidence. The site is password-gated and noindex/nofollow, while compliance indicates HTTPS only; complete TLS configuration is not evidenced. Access-boundary protection, alert-rule and sync-result handling, operational-log exposure, hosting-data controls, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Risk severity is high for public exposure and evidence_needed for control assurance. Missing telemetry is not evidence of compromise or a clean bill of health. Continue only existing approved measurement and separately authorized low-risk reversible work; optional hardening alone does not block ordinary growth.

Required security evidence before reconsidering go-live: document authentication and authorization boundaries for the private preview, secrets storage and rotation, container/runtime isolation, release and deploy approvals with rollback, complete TLS configuration, dependency and supply-chain controls, data minimization and retention, monitoring and incident signals, incident-response ownership, and disclosure/security.txt readiness. Evidence must be owner-approved and read-only where possible; do not create credentials, alter access controls, deploy, or expose new data as part of this review.

No security-sensitive implementation proposal is retained this cycle. Existing Great American Lakes measurement may continue without duplication or security-related production changes. Do not declare SearchWoot launch readiness from absent evidence.

No public exposure, credential, access-control, telemetry, infrastructure, schedule, deployment, or data-handling changes are authorized. Existing approved measurement and narrowly scoped reversible queue metadata work may continue.
